name.en: Lufer the Symbol of the Devils

requirement.en: When your opponent Normal or Special Summons a monster.

effect.en: Choose 2 Attack Position monsters on your field with 2500 or less ATK and different Types. This turn, those monsters cannot be destroyed by card effects or returned to the hand, Deck, or Extra Deck by card effects. Then, if you have "Micha the Symbol of the Angels" in your Graveyard, you can return 1 face-up Level 8 or lower monster from your opponent's field to the owner's hand.
